# Card fraud

Fraud rate profiles with Wilson intervals. Right metrics for imbalanced problems
are PR-AUC, recall at alert budget and expected cost — **not** accuracy or
ROC-AUC alone.

## Fraud rate by card type

```{r}
#| echo: false
prof <- read_table("fraud_rate_by_card_type")
if (!is.null(prof)) print(prof) else cat("No fraud-rate profile in this run.\n")
```

## Cost-based threshold

`cost_threshold()` chooses a cut-off from the cost of a missed fraud versus a
false alert. Evaluate on a **time-ordered** split; never oversample before splitting.

## Model card

Any predictive fraud model must have a card in `docs/MODEL-CARDS/fraud_detection.md`.
